ref: heilbronn-site search/ — square n=32 record scored as a convex configuration
note: Marc-Emmanuel Coupvent des Graviers's square n=32 configuration, unchanged. Only eight of its points lie on the boundary, so its convex hull is an octagon of area 0.994, and dividing by hull area lifts the value 0.53% above the previous convex record. D4 symmetric; 64 tied minimal triangles against 58 degrees of freedom, so it is rigid in the free frame too: trust-region polish and basin hopping under the convex objective find no improvement.
